title: Service Reliability Credit Values for Electric Service Agreement Schedules
content:
The service reliability credits on an Electric Service Agreement are valued per rate schedule. The figures below are the schedule's own outage credit values.

## Schedule values

Columns: RS is Schedule RS Residential Standard Service, RT is Schedule RT Residential Time-of-Use Service, REV is Schedule REV Residential Electric Vehicle Time-of-Use Service, GS is Schedule GS Small General Service, GST is Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service, GD is Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service and LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

| Term | RS | RT | REV | GS | GST | GD | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum outage duration for a sustained-outage credit, hours | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 16 | 12 |
| Outage credit base amount, USD | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 200.00 | 500.00 |
| Outage credit increment amount, USD | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 100.00 | 250.00 |
| Outage credit increment length, hours | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Outage credit cap per outage, USD | 135.00 | 135.00 | 135.00 | 275.00 | 275.00 | 600.00 | 1500.00 |
| Outage credit claim window, calendar days after restoration | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 60 |
| Major event day outages excluded | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Chronic outage count threshold, records in a rolling 12 months | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 8 | 8 |
| Chronic outage credit amount, USD | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 150.00 | 300.00 |

## What each value is

1. **Minimum outage credit duration** — the minimum continuous outage duration at the service address that qualifies for a sustained-outage credit, in hours.
2. **Outage credit base amount** — the sustained-outage credit for an outage reaching the minimum duration, in USD.
3. **Outage credit increment amount** — the additional credit for each full increment of outage duration beyond the minimum, in USD.
4. **Outage credit increment hours** — the length of one outage-duration increment, in hours.
5. **Outage credit cap** — the maximum sustained-outage credit for a single outage, in USD.
6. **Claim window** — the calendar days after restoration within which the outage credit must be requested.
7. **Major event day exclusion** — whether outages recorded on a declared major event day are excluded from outage credits; "yes" on every schedule.
8. **Chronic outage count threshold** — the number of outage records at the service address within a rolling 12 months at which the chronic-outage credit is earned.
9. **Chronic outage credit amount** — the chronic-outage credit in USD, paid at most once per rolling 12 months.

## Values grouped by schedule family

| Family | Minimum hours | Base | Increment (per 12 hours) | Cap | Claim window | Chronic threshold | Chronic credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential (RS, RT, REV) | 24 | 35.00 | 25.00 | 135.00 | 90 days | 6 | 25.00 |
| Small general (GS, GST) | 24 | 75.00 | 50.00 | 275.00 | 90 days | 6 | 50.00 |
| Medium general demand (GD) | 16 | 200.00 | 100.00 | 600.00 | 90 days | 8 | 150.00 |
| Large power (LP) | 12 | 500.00 | 250.00 | 1500.00 | 60 days | 8 | 300.00 |

Amounts are in USD.
